meta.title: Awesome Editor: a rich-text editor for any framework
meta.description: A rich-text editor with a single core for Vue, Nuxt, React, Angular and plain HTML. In private development: try it here and get in touch if you're interested.

hero.subtitle: One core, one interface and the same behaviour in Vue, Nuxt, React, Angular or a plain HTML page. Handmade, with its own document model.

demo.title: Try it right here
demo.subtitle: This is the real editor, not a video. Type, paste, build tables, export to Word. Nothing leaves your browser.
demo.notePaste: paste here from Word or Docs
demo.label: Demo editor

frameworks.title: One editor, every framework
frameworks.body: Components for Vue/Nuxt, React and Angular, plus an <awesome-editor> element for any other page. They all share the same interface.

model.title: A JSON model, not HTML
model.body: The document is its own validated structure. HTML is an output, not the source of truth, so content stays clean.

plugins.title: Real plugins
plugins.body: Tables, mentions, emoji, find and replace, context menus… Every feature is a plugin you can remove or write yourself.

files.title: Open, print and export
files.body: Import Markdown, HTML and Word; export to Markdown, HTML, Word (.docx) and PDF, or print straight away.

i18n.title: Five languages
i18n.body: Spanish, English, French, German and Portuguese built into the whole interface.

themes.title: Light and dark
themes.body: CSS-variable themes that follow the system or your choice, and that you can adapt to your brand.

status.title: Interested?
status.body: Awesome Editor isn't public yet. If you'd like to use it in a project, share feedback or collaborate, drop me a line.

footer.colophon: Set and proofread by hand by Abdellah
